A '''staging area''' for [[Pirin City]]'s mines was located about ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] from the [[City/Legends|city]]. [[Speeder truck/Legends|Speeder trucks]] owned by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] carried [[Miner/Legends|miners]] to and from the staging area.<ref name="Strongholds" />
